predictions.mechanism: Renewed Iranian ballistic-missile production signals persistence of the conflict and supports safe-haven demand, while a soft DXY helps gold; very high yields cap conviction.
predictions.invalidation: A verified ceasefire or rapid de-escalation combined with falling regional risk premia would weaken the safe-haven bid.

predictions.mechanism: A renewed weapons-production signal increases perceived conflict duration and energy-supply risk while oil and Treasury yields are already elevated, pressuring broad equity valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Verified de-escalation or a sharp reversal lower in oil and Treasury yields would weaken the bearish impulse.

predictions.mechanism: Geopolitical risk-off pressure combines with near-5% long yields, a direct valuation headwind for long-duration growth stocks.
predictions.invalidation: A sharp decline in Treasury yields alongside verified Middle East de-escalation would favor upside instead.
